grammarFocus: 主题句与支持句；although / while；because 与 because of。
title: Why Group Projects Teach More Than Just the Subject
instructions: 阅读下面的文章，回答10个问题。文章是关于教育话题的模拟材料，不是真实的研究或官方考试。题目类型包括单选、填空、匹配（用单选形式）和判断正误/未提及。填空答案必须来自原文，且不超过字数限制。所有解释为中文，证据为英文原文引用。
passage:
A
Group projects are common in many classrooms, but some students dislike them. They worry that one person will do all the work while others do nothing. However, teachers often use group work for a reason: it teaches skills that individual study cannot. Although group projects can be difficult, they help students learn teamwork, communication, and problem-solving. These skills are useful in almost every job. In fact, many teachers believe that group work is as important as the subject itself. They say that students who learn to work with others will be more successful in their future careers. For example, a student who can explain ideas clearly may become a better doctor, engineer, or manager. Therefore, group work is not just a way to finish a task quickly; it is a way to prepare for life beyond school.

B
One of the main benefits of group work is that it prepares students for the workplace. In most jobs, people need to work with others. Because employers value teamwork, schools try to give students practice. While some students prefer to work alone, they still need to learn how to cooperate. For example, a student who is good at math may need to explain ideas to a classmate who is better at writing. This exchange helps both students improve. Another example is when students divide tasks: one student researches, another writes, and a third presents. Each student learns to rely on others and to be reliable. These experiences are similar to real work situations. In many companies, teams meet regularly to share progress and solve problems together. Students who have done group projects often find it easier to join such teams because they already know how to listen, share, and compromise.

C
Another advantage is that group work can improve understanding. When students explain their ideas to others, they must think more carefully. This process, called peer teaching, helps both the teacher and the learner. Because of this, many teachers assign group projects even in large classes. Although it takes time to organize groups, the results are often positive. Students who teach others remember the material better. In addition, group work can help students develop social skills. They learn to listen, to share ideas, and to give feedback politely. These skills are valuable not only in school but also in everyday life. For instance, when students discuss a history topic, they hear different opinions and learn to respect them. This makes them more open-minded and better prepared for a diverse society.

D
However, group work has challenges. One common problem is that some students do not contribute equally. This can cause frustration. Because of this, teachers often use peer assessment, where students rate each other's work. While peer assessment can be fair, it can also be difficult for friends to judge each other honestly. Another challenge is that group work takes more time than individual work. Teachers must plan carefully to avoid wasting time. Sometimes, group work can also lead to conflict if students disagree. Teachers need to be ready to help students solve these problems. Despite these challenges, many teachers still believe that the benefits of group work are greater than the difficulties. They argue that learning to handle disagreement is itself an important skill for adult life.

E
To make group work successful, teachers should give clear instructions and assign specific roles. For instance, one student can be the leader, another the note-taker, and another the presenter. Because each student has a role, everyone must participate. Although some students may still prefer to work alone, learning to work in a team is an important life skill. In conclusion, while group projects are not perfect, they offer valuable lessons that go beyond the subject matter. They teach students how to cooperate, communicate, and solve problems together. These are skills that will help them throughout their lives. Moreover, group work can build confidence, as students see that their individual efforts contribute to a shared success. In this way, group projects prepare students not only for exams but also for the challenges of the modern world.

Group projects help students learn important skills despite some challenges.
Teachers should stop using group projects.
Individual study is better than group work.

grammar.title: 主题句与支持句；although / while；because 与 because of
grammar.explanation: 主题句表达段落的主要观点，支持句用细节、例子或原因来支持主题句。although 和 while 表示让步或对比，后面接完整的句子。because 后面接句子，because of 后面接名词或名词短语。
grammar.example: Although group projects can be difficult, they help students learn teamwork, communication, and problem-solving.

options: Although it was raining, we went for a walk.
Although it was raining, but we went for a walk.
Although it was raining, we went for a walk because of rain.
Although it was raining, so we went for a walk.
answers: Although it was raining, we went for a walk.
questions.explanation: although 引导让步状语从句，主句前不再加 but 或 so。
questions.evidence: Although group projects can be difficult, they help students learn teamwork, communication, and problem-solving.

options: She stayed home because of she was sick.
She stayed home because she was sick.
She stayed home because of she was sick.
She stayed home because she was sickness.
answers: She stayed home because she was sick.
questions.explanation: because 后面接句子（she was sick），because of 后面接名词短语。
questions.evidence: Because employers value teamwork, schools try to give students practice.

options: While I like coffee, my sister likes tea.
While I like coffee, but my sister likes tea.
While I like coffee, so my sister likes tea.
While I like coffee, my sister likes tea because.
answers: While I like coffee, my sister likes tea.
questions.explanation: while 表示对比，连接两个句子，不需要 but 或 so。
questions.evidence: While some students prefer to work alone, they still need to learn how to cooperate.

options: The game was canceled because of the rain.
The game was canceled because the rain.
The game was canceled because of it rained.
The game was canceled because rain.
answers: The game was canceled because of the rain.
questions.explanation: because of 后面接名词短语（the rain），because 后面接句子。
questions.evidence: Because of this, many teachers assign group projects even in large classes.
